assets.altText: Four fictional adult women in turquoise, rose, cobalt and emerald metallic couture link hands beside a curved Sea Garden balustrade overlooking the Black Sea at blue hour.
Four fictional adult women in short opaque turquoise, rose, cobalt and emerald couture link hands on Varna's Sea Garden promenade as the far-right woman kisses the third woman's cheek.
Four fictional adult women in rose, white-blue, violet and green-black couture stand together on a guarded terrace inside Devetashka Cave, with daylight openings and a green valley beyond.
Full-length view of four fictional adult women in short opaque futuristic couture on a guarded Devetashka Cave terrace beneath the immense limestone arch and daylight openings.
Extreme-close portrait of four fictional adult women in metallic couture linking hands at a guarded Melnik overlook, with golden sandstone pyramids and vineyard rows behind them.

Extreme-close portrait of four fictional adult women in green-gold, copper, cobalt and silver-plum couture linking hands as the far-right woman kisses the third woman's cheek, with Melnik's golden sandstone pyramids and vineyard rows behind them.
Extreme-close portrait of four fictional adult women sharing a cheek kiss and linked hands on the Pobiti Kamani geological trail, surrounded by upright limestone columns and pale sand.

Extreme-close portrait at Pobiti Kamani of three fully visible fictional adult women and a partially cropped fourth woman sharing a cheek kiss, linked hands and a collar-fastening gesture among limestone columns.
